text:
Aisha (AE): Hey team — need quick approval for Acorn AI (YC W23). They want a starter grant to run a 90-day POC (chat + embeddings). Ask: $7k in credits, no commit. Security has given a pass but they require KMS + 30-day data retention. Any objections to approving non-committed credits?

Samir (SE): Heads-up on technical footprint: expect ~3M generated tokens and ~100k embedding ops across the POC. Peak load for demo might hit 2x A100-equivalent concurrency; recommend Hosted sandbox + throttles for the POC. No private infra needed at first. Rough cost split: propose $5k for gen tokens, $2k for embeddings (matches their request). Also recommend enabling prefix cache to reduce token burn during demos.

Jordan (DealDesk): Can we do $7k no-commit? For YC stage we usually allow up to $10k, but RevOps needs to sign off for no-commit grants. Also need Legal ok for KMS/data-retention. If we approve, how will we track usage against the grant? :thinking:

Maya (RevOps): We can approve up to $8k no-commit for YC companies under the Startup Program, with 90-day expiry and pilot badge. If they agree to a modest follow-on commit (example: $1k/mo for 6 months) we can expand to $12k. Suggested structure to present to the customer:

```
Option A — No-commit Starter: $8,000 credits, 90d expiry, standard pilot addendum, KMS optional, 30d retention
Option B — Commitment Boost: $12,000 credits, 6-month $1k/mo paid commit (discount applies), extended support window
```

We also require they fill in the pilot intake form and provide a technical contact for SOC2 attestation.

Elena (Legal): KMS + 30-day retention is fine but add an explicit data-treatment clause in the pilot addendum: forbid exporting Redwood-hosted customer data after termination without written request and allow us to delete backups after retention window. Recommend using our standard Pilot Addendum + a one-paragraph KMS acknowledgement. Also, confirm customer legal contact and any CNIs.

DealBot: Quota update: applied 8000 credits to org/acorn-ai (grant-id: grant_1921). Expiry set to 2024-12-01. Notifying billing & revops channels.

Aisha (AE): Thanks all — I'll pivot the ask to $8k and propose Option B as an upsell. I'll get the pilot addendum signed and request SOC2 attestation contact. Samir, can you draft a short test plan and throttling spec we can attach?

Samir (SE): On it — will share a simple test-plan + minimal config with expected QPS and cache toggles by EOD.

Jordan (DealDesk): Approving $8k no-commit starter grant. Please ensure Pilot Addendum is signed and send copy to dealdesk@redwood.com for tracking. @Maya please watch usage and flag any overage early. :white_check_mark:
